subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a repaired helper plus live or sanctioned Feishu/CardKit proof before merge, or accept a proof override for this external Feishu streaming-card fix?
rationale: The contributor states they cannot access a live Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming setup, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked dispatcher tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a visible channel change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the final-chunk helper, refresh the branch, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or maintainer-run proof before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the final-chunk helper, refresh the branch, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or maintainer-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live PR assignee and recent Feishu streaming-card area contributor, so they are the best current owner for proof override or branch disposition.
